detail.longDescription: Vermont’s Live Eaglecam Photo: Vermont Institute of Natural Science (VINS). An adult bald eagle brought food to the nest on May 27. Some people think that watching wildlife doing its thing on live video is like watching paint dry. Others find it soothing. And of course there are moments when it can be really exciting. In Vermont this summer, all those attitudes were in play as members of one bald eagle family unwittingly gave up its privacy for science.
